title: Chakra, Hawkins, Frequency & Psychology Crosswalk
status: comparative spiritual-psychological atlas with explicit scientific boundaries
purpose: Cross the Potatoverse five-spinal-chakra + higher-center architecture with major chakra traditions, David R. Hawkins' Map of Consciousness, real EEG frequency bands, affective psychology, resonance/transition analogies and the Door/Ladder model without pretending that Hawkins calibration numbers are literal hertz or that chakras are measured neural oscillators.
core_boundary: Three different things are kept separate: (1) spiritual/chakra and Hawkins maps, (2) subjective psychological state, and (3) measured physical frequencies. A useful structural mapping does not establish equality among them.

chakra_tradition_registry.finding: There is no single universal chakra count. Buddhist tantric systems include five, six, eighteen and other counts; modern Kundalini presentations commonly use seven centers. The Western rainbow/endocrine/psychological chakra system was assembled historically through late-19th and 20th-century esoteric synthesis rather than simply copied intact from one ancient source.

potatoverse_higher_extension.status: Potatoverse-specific extension, not universal historical chakra doctrine

potatoverse_higher_extension.rule: Add only when a specific Timic source, historical tradition or clearly labeled later project formalization supplies a distinct center. Do not manufacture a fixed 8-12 chakra ladder from generic New Age lists.

hawkins_map.author: David R. Hawkins
hawkins_map.historical_claim: Hawkins proposed a logarithmic consciousness scale calibrated through applied kinesiology/muscle testing. The familiar named levels include Shame 20, Guilt 30, Apathy 50, Grief 75, Fear 100, Desire 125, Anger 150, Pride 175, Courage 200, Neutrality 250, Willingness 310, Acceptance 350, Reason 400, Love 500, Joy 540, Peace 600 and Enlightenment 700-1000.
hawkins_map.scientific_boundary: These calibration numbers are not scientifically established frequencies in hertz. Applied kinesiology has not demonstrated reliable diagnostic validity in higher-quality controlled research, so Hawkins' scale is retained as a spiritual/phenomenological map, not a measured physical spectrum.

hawkins_levels.name: Courage
hawkins_levels.potatoverse_relation: candidate Door threshold / transition from contraction-dominated to constructive action

psychology_coordinate_system.preferred_empirical_map: Instead of treating emotions as a literal one-dimensional vibration ladder, represent affect as at least a two-dimensional state.
psychology_coordinate_system.scientific_anchor: The circumplex model of affect uses valence and arousal as major independent dimensions.

real_hertz_registry.rule: Hz is cycles per second. Only processes that actually oscillate periodically can be assigned a physical frequency in Hz.

entrainment_and_resonance.finding: Neural oscillations can sometimes be entrained or phase-biased by rhythmic sensory or noninvasive stimulation. This is a real frequency-dependent phenomenon, but effects depend strongly on method, brain state, timing and measurement.
entrainment_and_resonance.project_use: This is the rigorous physical/psychological neighbor for 'choosing a vibe' when a real rhythmic stimulus is present. It does not mean choosing Love 500 causes the brain to oscillate at 500 Hz.

electron_groove_analogy.user_intuition: Hawkins-style levels can be imagined like electron grooves: select a state, meet a transition condition, then enter another stable regime.
electron_groove_analogy.physics_correction: Electrons do not travel in literal circular grooves. Atomic electrons occupy quantized quantum states/orbitals characterized by quantum numbers. Atomic transitions occur between allowed energy states.
electron_groove_analogy.timic_translation: state basin ↔ 'groove'; compatibility/threshold ↔ Gate; transition operator ↔ Door; exchanged signal/resource ↔ handshake; new stable state ↔ entered level.
electron_groove_analogy.mismatch: Hawkins numbers are not quantum energies; chakras are not orbitals; emotion transitions do not obey atomic selection rules.

vibe_to_gate_model.meaning: Each Gate k has a preferred psychological direction s_k and threshold θ_k. A current state is more compatible with some Gates than others. Crossing τ permits a Door transition.
vibe_to_gate_model.boundary: This is a state-machine formalization for research and journaling, not evidence that emotions occupy objective metaphysical frequency bands.

chakra_hawkins_crosswalk_rule: Do not assign one Hawkins level permanently to one chakra. Use many-to-many relationships. Fear may strongly recruit Root themes; Desire may recruit Sacral; Anger/agency may recruit Navel; Love/Grief may recruit Heart; Courage/Truth may recruit Throat; Reason/Discernment may recruit Eye; Peace/Enlightenment may recruit Crown/Spudlight. But the same emotion can involve multiple body regions and cognitive systems.

candidate_many_to_many_links.psychology: approach motivation, arousal, agency, status, expression
care, positive affect, social openness, expression

research_protocol: record Hawkins label separately from self-rated valence/arousal/control
record chakra/spinal/higher-center association separately from physical body sensation
record EEG frequency only when actually measured
record stimulus frequency only when there is a real periodic input
test whether chosen 'vibe' predicts behavior, attention, body state or social response better than ordinary affect variables
do not convert Hawkins calibration numbers into Hz
use Gate/transition models to generate falsifiable behavioral predictions instead of physicalizing metaphor
